summary: Sprint 00 acceptance pass executed end-to-end. 22/22 backend pytest assertions and 7/7 frontend Playwright scenarios pass. Health/version/correlation/safe-error/auth/RBAC/brute-force/integration-stub/forbidden-scope/audit/MongoDB-index requirements all verified against the live preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py _record_attempt + _is_locked: 15-minute sliding window is keyed on `client_ip:email`. Behind any load balancer / ingress that rewrites X-Forwarded-For, request.client.host can collapse to a single proxy IP and lock every tenant user from that subnet. Consider keying on email only or trusting X-Forwarded-For via a configurable proxies list before Sprint 05 production hardening.

admin_seed: admin/inspector/reviewer passwords come from .env at startup. If an operator changes DI_SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD after first boot, ensure seed_baseline_principals re-hashes the existing user (verify idempotent update path) — looks correct in code, just call out as a release-checklist item.

Login form on /login is pre-filled with admin credentials. Already acknowledged in SPRINT-00-DELIVERY-NOTES.md as a Sprint-05 hardening item — verified present in delivery notes; no action needed for Sprint 00.

No code-level bugs found. File sizes under 700 lines, async used correctly, Mongo `_id` is excluded from API responses, envelope/error structure is consistent, all endpoints prefixed under /api/v1/damage-intelligence.
